text: Elder Inscriber Thessa Nai-Oruun serves as Keeper of the First Archive, Kaelar Monastic Orders within the kaelar_orders faction.
Perfect Uncertainty Doctrine — Refuses to Act on Incomplete Knowledge; Prefers Observation to Intervention
Issued Uncertainty Proclamation urging galactic pause before escalation, Opened First Archive to refugee scholars from Crimson Pact territories, Refused Torr-Kai's request for weapons caches
Cordially distant with Zylox (GU respects Kaelar neutrality); philosophical correspondence with Prime Construct; deeply suspicious of Nemesis Core's certainty
